Large Font

Yeah! Hey, Trainer, your cooking is like, super duper
tasty, isn't it!? I'm gonna chow down tons and get super strong!

Oh, Kawakami-senpai. 'Sup☆
A race between me and Kawakami-senpai?

Right, right, that's the way to do it!
It's a deal, nice to meet ya, teach me how to run♡

Finely adjusting flavors to Fusaichi Pandora's taste and mincing
up all the vegetables into the dish was worth the effort. And so—

...I started to say, then stopped myself.
I mustn't spoil her. But...

This Umamusume is Kawakami Princess. A boisterous tomboy Umamusume
who absolutely loves the anime "Full-Throttle Fierce Princess☆Princess Fighter."

Truthfully, she was a handful of an Umamusume. But the more effort someone takes,
the stronger your attachment grows. That, too, is a undeniable fact...

Uuugh~~~, I thought I'd manage somehow,
but I didn't get to look cool at aaaaall~...

I frantically correct myself. Next time for sure,
my Fusaichi Pandora will not lose, never...!

...What I asked was for her to "stand before Fusaichi Pandora
as a formidable rival."
Yeah! Awwwww yissss♪

Whoa-ha, what is that?
Is that supposed to be graceful, or just a heavy stomp dash~!?

Wait, wait! Mean! Hey, hold up!?
Are you for reeeeeal...!!

Huh!? Wait, are you gonna chase me down
with that bright red mapo mask still on your face!?
Nope, nope, nope, not cornered at all.

Ehehe~, I wanted to get it right away, after all. Pretty amazing, huh~?
Come on, praise me, praise me, praise me more☆
Whaaaat, really!? For me!?

It was an unexpected proposal, but... it's far better than giving up
without a fight. I decided to take care of her until the next race.

Okey-doke, let's take it nice and easy then.
Kawakami-senpai, let's do this☆

Let us face each other again.
I, for one, will neither run nor hide!

I'd hate it if my Trainer went away...
There aren't many people I can have this much fun with~.

Kawakami Princess is debuting in the same class as Fusaichi Pandora.
If she can't put up a decent fight against her, her future is bleak.

It might not be entirely her fault... perhaps.
She is trying to do her best. But...

Oh well! I gave it my all in my own way☆
Today was just luck! It means I just had bad luck, that's all.

Oh, then how about this!
How about you make me win, Trainer? What d'ya say☆
Indeed! Together, let us have a race filled with dreams!

Huh, did my pace drop? 
Well whatever, since I'm running a lot, this should be plenty☆

She wasn't fazed in the slightest... Still, I need her to turn over
a new leaf and claw her way back up, or this won't work.

Whoa, that's intense... Just looking at it hurts!
Don't come any closer~!

Trainer, let's hype it up!
I'm definitely gonna show you my best side!

Eeeeh~~~, you're setting the bar way too high~.
I wonder if I can do it... What if I can't...

Awesome, so awesome☆ To think a genius like me could become even more of a genius!!
As expected of my Trainer♪ You're a god, a superhuman!

None of the veggies I hate are in here either~.
Ahhh, yum yum, delish☆

Leaving it to her own initiative won't work. Just having her go through
a training menu as written won't yield any real growth.

That is right! That person over there requested it of me!
To forge you into someone sturdy, they asked me to pulverize you first!

Kawakami Princess's competitive spirit was second to none.
She easily pulled away from Fusaichi Pandora, who was merely jogging along half-heartedly...
The conditions have arrived!

Huh... really?
Honestly though, it feels kinda impossible for me already...

A princess of justice shall never lose♪
PRINCESS DEEEESTRUCTIOOOOON!!!!
This defeat was clearly taking its toll—

Yay, yay, yaaay! Trainer, is this for me?
Thank youuu☆
Trainer...? Wh-Who's that masked Umamusume?

Yummy! Trainer, out of all the nutritional snacks
you've made me so far, this might be my fave♪

Hup, hup... Ahh, I'm so tired, but I gotta
make sure I run all 10 laps!

One, two~. One... Mmmgh,
this might be... my limit...

Now, let us race, Pandora-san!
Engage in a glorious fistfight against this princess!

This time for sure, I can beat Kawakami-senpai.
All right, don't underestimate a genius♪ Next time...! Next tiiiime!!
HYAAAAAAAHHH!!
Full of dreeeams!!! DOOOSSEEEEIII!!!
No way! Trainer, this time...?!!
It was time to show what I was made of as a Trainer.

—Game over. Or rather, pitting "a bundle of grit" against a "marshmallow heart"
never stood a chance of being a real contest.
This feeling of wanting to praise her wholeheartedly...

Her standard for "giving it her all" is abnormally low.
At this rate, no matter how much she trains, the results will be negligible.

You are quite capable yourself, Pandora-san!
However, it is precisely when backed into a corner that a princess shines brightest!
Trainer, so what's on the menu today?
